description: This file defines the ParticipantId struct, including its roles and associated methods, as well as extension methods for participant role filtering.

classes.name: ParticipantId
classes.description: A struct representing a participant with a name, reference, and supported roles in a distributed transaction system.

classes.name: ParticipantId.IdComparer
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IEqualityComparer for ParticipantId, comparing based on name and reference.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ParticipantId.

methods.name: SupportsRoles
methods.description: Extension method to check if a participant supports a specific role.

methods.name: IsResource
methods.description: Extension method to check if a participant is a resource.

methods.name: IsManager
methods.description: Extension method to check if a participant is a manager.

methods.name: IsPriorityManager
methods.description: Extension method to check if a participant is a priority manager.

methods.name: SelectResources
methods.description: Filters a collection to only include resource participants.

methods.name: SelectManagers
methods.description: Filters a collection to only include manager participants.

methods.name: SelectPriorityManagers
methods.description: Filters a collection to only include priority manager participants.
